yt.title: Your card's last digit catches {c_single} of typos #Shorts
yt.description:
The Luhn check digit. We tested every one-digit typo and every adjacent swap on 2,000 random numbers. Test card numbers only.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.text: Your card's last digit is a typo trap
scenes.narration: Your card's last digit is a trap for typos.

rows.t: Double every 2nd digit, from the right

scenes.narration: Take a test number. From the right, double every second digit. Add all the digits up: eighty. It ends in zero, so it passes.

scenes.label: we tested every one
scenes.narration: We tried every single-digit typo. It caught {c_single_say} percent.
And about {c_trans_say} percent of swapped neighbors.
It catches typos. It does not make your card safe.
